newsitem.title: LIBERIA: Liberia's Taylor to marry again on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Liberia's Taylor to marry again on Tuesday.

text.p: Faction leader Charles Taylor, the man who launched Liberia's civil war in 1989, is to marry his long-standing girl-friend Juwel Howard on Tuesday at his inland Gbarnga headquarters, supporters say.
Howard is deputy governor at Liberia's Central Bank.
Taylor supporters say the wedding was switched from the capital Monrovia to Gbarnga for security reasons. Some said a hit squad planned to assassinate Taylor on his wedding day.
Taylor, who has been married once before, plans to stand for president in elections planned for May under a West African-brokered peace deal -- provided Liberia's warlords disarm in time.
His previous wife Agnes has been living in Burkina Faso.
